headline.zh: 从普惠到质量，从参与到影响
headline.en: From inclusion to quality, from participation to impact

lead.zh: 人工智能的发展，使开源的协作对象从代码进一步延伸到模型、数据和智能体。开放成果不断积累，新的参与者与技术方向持续出现。与此同时，供给能否被理解和复用、关键基础能否得到维护、更多人能否进入共同创新，成为判断开源发展质量的重要问题。
lead.en: Artificial intelligence is extending open collaboration from code to models, data and agents. Shared assets continue to accumulate, alongside new participants and technical directions. The quality of this development depends on whether those assets can be understood and reused, whether foundational systems can be maintained, and whether more people can participate in innovation.

thesis.zh: 《2026 全球开源发展报告》的核心主张是：将扩大参与和开放供给，与持续贡献、共同维护及公共价值连接起来。报告以开源发展目标（OSDGs）和开源发展指标（OSDI）为共同框架，通过生态地图、影响力榜单、技术全景和模型生态分析，观察开放成果怎样成为下一次创造的基础。发展成效既要看规模，也要看协作能否延续、成果能否积累、受益机会能否扩大。
thesis.en: The Global Open Source Development Report 2026 argues for connecting wider participation and open supply with sustained contribution, shared maintenance and public value. Open Source Development Goals (OSDGs) and Open Source Development Indicators (OSDI) provide a common framework for ecosystem maps, influence rankings, technology landscapes and model analysis. Development should be assessed through scale, but also through continuity of collaboration, reusable foundations and wider opportunities to benefit.

title.zh: 参与基础与协作影响，需要分别观察。
title.en: Participation and collaborative influence require distinct measures.

body.zh: 第二章地图与第三章榜单表明，参与者数量与协作网络中的影响力位次并不总是一致。较大的开发者基础提供了发展条件，将其转化为持续贡献和项目影响，还需要真实任务、人才成长与组织支持。评价地区发展，应同时观察参与、贡献、项目与核心人才，避免将人数或单一排名作为全部成效。
body.en: The maps in Chapter 2 and rankings in Chapter 3 show that participant numbers and influence within collaboration networks do not always align. A broad developer base creates opportunities; sustained contribution and project influence also require meaningful tasks, professional growth and organizational support. Regional assessment should consider participation, contributions, projects and core contributors together, rather than rely on headcounts or a single ranking.

title.zh: 开放生态的持续影响，依赖组织化协作与共同维护。
title.en: Lasting influence depends on organized collaboration and shared maintenance.

body.zh: 区域、企业、基金会和项目榜单揭示了不同主体在协作网络中的位置。企业连接研发资源与产品实践，基金会与社区承接跨组织协作，维护者让共同成果持续可用。由此，影响力观察应进一步连接责任与资源：哪些基础被反复使用，谁承担维护，使用者如何回馈上游。榜单提供识别对象的入口，长期支持仍应结合具体维护需求。
body.en: Rankings of regions, companies, foundations and projects reveal different positions within collaboration networks. Companies connect engineering resources with product use; foundations and communities support cooperation across organizations; maintainers keep shared assets usable. Influence assessment should therefore connect network position to responsibilities and resources: which foundations are reused, who maintains them, and how users contribute upstream. Rankings help identify candidates for attention, while sustained support requires evidence of maintenance needs.

title.zh: AI 开源生态的建设重点，正在扩展到完整技术体系。
title.en: Open AI development requires investment across the technology stack.

body.zh: 第四章的 Agentic AI 全景将项目放回智能体与模型基础设施的技术分类中，呈现任务入口、编排、工具、记忆、评估与运行基础之间的分工。第三章中 PyTorch、vLLM 等项目的生态位置，也提示基础技术的重要性。对公共部门与产业而言，支持方向应覆盖可复用的基础工具、互操作与公开评测，使应用创新拥有稳定的共同基础。
body.en: The Agentic AI landscape in Chapter 4 places projects within agent and model infrastructure, distinguishing task interfaces, orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation and runtime foundations. The positions of projects such as PyTorch and vLLM in Chapter 3 also highlight the role of foundational technology. Public and industry support should extend to reusable tools, interoperability and open evaluation, giving application innovation dependable shared foundations.

title.zh: 模型供给迅速扩张，复用关系成为理解生态的重要线索。
title.en: Rapid growth in model supply makes reuse an essential part of ecosystem analysis.

body.zh: 按 2026 年 9 月同一快照中仍可见模型的创建时间回溯，模型数量较上年同日增长 58.3%，派生模型增长 52.3%。在第五章另一个覆盖 826 个组织账号的地域样本中，中美合计占模型数量的 71.7%；可识别的跨国派生记录同时呈现基座供给与下游开发之间的连接。这些证据提示，模型生态需要同时观察供给规模、发布主体和后续创造，支持既要回应关键基座的维护需求，也要为更多地区与团队保留参与机会。上述快照与样本分别解释，不能视为全球完整存量或国家贡献总量。
body.en: A reconstruction by creation date within the September 2026 snapshot shows 58.3% growth in visible models and 52.3% growth in derivative models from the same date a year earlier. In a separate geographic sample of 826 organizational accounts in Chapter 5, China and the United States together account for 71.7% of models. Identifiable cross-border derivative records also connect base-model supply with downstream development. Model ecosystems therefore need to be understood through supply, publishers and subsequent creation. Support should address key base-model maintenance while enabling participation by more regions and teams. These snapshots and samples have distinct scopes; they are not complete global inventories or national contribution totals.

title.zh: 开放许可、完整交付与公共价值，需要建立各自的证据。
title.en: Licensing, technical completeness and public value each require evidence.

body.zh: 第五章的 870 个评估样本中，600 个归入高开放组，同时达到高完整与高开放的只有 117 个，占全体样本的 13.4%。许可条件与技术材料并不同步，公开成果也不自动意味着能够复现或产生公共收益。政策与采购应面向具体版本和用途，分别核验材料、许可、运行验证及真实使用结果，把开放承诺落实为可持续的协作条件。
body.en: Among the 870 evaluated models in Chapter 5, 600 fall within the report’s higher-openness group, but only 117—13.4% of the full sample—combine higher openness with higher technical completeness. Licensing and technical materials do not necessarily advance together; publication alone does not establish reproducibility or public benefit. Policy and procurement should examine materials, licensing, validation and actual outcomes for specific versions and uses, turning openness commitments into workable conditions for sustained collaboration.

priorities_title.zh: 三项共同任务，推动发展质量提升
priorities_title.en: Three shared priorities for better development outcomes

priorities_intro.zh: 基于这些观察，报告提出三项相互支撑的共同任务，并在第六章分别落实为政府与国际组织、企业与组织、社区与全球合作的九条建议。
priorities_intro.en: The report proposes three mutually reinforcing priorities. Chapter 6 translates them into nine recommendations for governments and international organizations, companies and organizations, and communities and global cooperation.

title.zh: 支持持续参与与人才成长。
title.en: Support continued participation and contributor growth.

body.zh: 把人才支持连接到真实共建任务，为新人提供导师、文档和远程协作机会，为持续贡献者提供时间与认可，为维护者提供接续支持。公共部门改善参与条件，企业将贡献纳入研发安排，社区建立从首次贡献到共同维护的成长路径。成效应体现在持续贡献与责任成长，而不止于注册或活动人数。
body.en: Connect talent support to real collaborative work. Provide mentoring, documentation and remote participation for newcomers, time and recognition for contributors, and succession support for maintainers. Public institutions can improve access, companies can make contribution part of engineering work, and communities can create paths from a first contribution to shared maintenance. Progress should be assessed through continued contribution and growing responsibility, alongside participation numbers.

title.zh: 建设可维护、可复用的开放技术基础。
title.en: Build open foundations that can be maintained and reused.

body.zh: 把支持从首次发布延伸到文档、测试、兼容适配、问题响应和长期维护。企业应识别关键上游并分担维护责任，公共资助与基金会可支持跨项目共用的工具、评测和复现条件，社区组织上下游共同工作。资源配置兼顾关键基础与服务特定语言、地区和任务的长尾项目。
body.en: Extend support beyond initial releases to documentation, testing, compatibility, issue response and ongoing maintenance. Companies should identify critical upstream dependencies and share maintenance responsibilities. Public funders and foundations can support common tools, evaluation and reproducibility, while communities organize upstream–downstream work. Resources should serve both widely used foundations and projects addressing specific languages, regions and tasks.

title.zh: 推进透明治理与可验证的公共价值。
title.en: Advance transparent governance and verifiable public value.

body.zh: 明确版本、材料、许可和维护责任，开放重要协作规则与决策记录。将教育、无障碍和公共服务等需求转化为由使用者共同参与的具体任务，以真实采用、受益范围与后续维护检验成果。国际合作可围绕共同任务、共享证据和双向反馈开展，让本地经验进入上游改进。
body.en: Make versions, materials, licenses and maintenance responsibilities clear, and document important collaboration rules and decisions. Translate needs in education, accessibility and public services into concrete tasks shaped with users. Assess results through actual adoption, who benefits and continued maintenance. International cooperation can organize shared tasks, evidence and two-way feedback so local experience informs upstream improvements.

closing.zh: 本报告最终关注的是持续共同创造及其公共价值：让更多人能够参与，让成果在维护与复用中不断发展，让开放协作的收益能够被解释、验证和延续。
closing.en: The report’s ultimate concern is sustained co-creation and its public value: enabling more people to participate, allowing shared assets to develop through maintenance and reuse, and making the benefits of open collaboration explainable, verifiable and enduring.

scope.zh: 研究以 2025.07—2026.06 为主统计期；模型快照等证据按各节标注日期独立解释。模拟内容不作为事实结论的依据，未完成核验的指标不视为已测算结果。
scope.en: The main reporting period is July 2025–June 2026. Model snapshots and other evidence retain the dates and scope stated in their sections. Simulations do not support factual conclusions, and indicators awaiting verification are not treated as completed measurements.
